$schema: Schema for portfolio project cards. See .claude/skills/update-projects/SKILL.md for how to add/update entries.

projects.name: Bearings
projects.pitch: Triangulates owls we hear in the Presidio woods on walks with my wife, by combining compass bearings from both our phones — also doubles as a "which mountain is that" and ski-chute finder.

projects.name: Clear Skies Ahead
projects.pitch: The Presidio is foggier than the Mission or Marin — this points you the exact direction and distance to walk to get out of the gloom and into the sun.

projects.name: Teaching Toddlers Typing
projects.pitch: A letter-matching keyboard game so my 2-year-old can "work" at a computer like everyone else in the house — press the matching key, no such thing as a wrong answer.

projects.name: Big Emotions
projects.pitch: Compares five parenting books side by side so we can decide whose philosophy we actually agree with — and know which one to read next.

projects.name: Ins-and-Outs
projects.pitch: A quick-tap tracker for a recovering dog's pills, pees, and poos, so anyone in the house can log a moment in two taps.

projects.name: BitLock
projects.pitch: Tracks which of 1,024 combinations we've tried on a 10-button lock I still haven't cracked, shared so every attempt counts.
projects.live_note: Deploy link stays private — it's where our one shared memory of attempted combinations actually lives, and I'm still cracking the lock.

projects.name: Ask the Stars
projects.pitch: Backcountry hiking and skiing puts you out of cell range right when you most want to check weather, fire, or trail conditions — this taps Apple's free satellite messaging to ask an AI agent directly, instead of hoping a friend is by their phone to relay the answer.

repo.private_reason: Stays private — it's wired to my personal Twilio account.

projects.name: Spotter
projects.pitch: Crowdsourced, geotagged photo sharing so the great race-day photos strangers took of you actually make it back to you.

repo.private_reason: Stays private for now — keeping the option open to take this one commercial.

projects.name: Kindling
projects.pitch: A relationship-maintenance app for keeping up with the small habits and check-ins that keep the spark alive.
